title: Local conservativity of ordinary restriction on arbitrary derived morphisms
statement: Fix ell,E and a qcqs scheme T [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism]. Use ordinary derived restriction [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models] in D of the completed integral coefficient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For any morphism f:H -> K: (1) restriction along an isomorphism S -> T reflects invertibility; (2) for an immersion r:S -> T and complementary qc open and closed immersions j:U -> S and i:Z -> S, r^*f is invertible iff (rj)^*f and (ri)^*f are; (3) for a nonempty immersed qcqs S -> T and a pro-etale covering family W_a -> S with qcqs domains, r^*f is invertible iff every (r W_a)^*f is. The site and coefficient universes, and the index universe of the cover, are independent. No completion unit occurs in this statement.

proof.text: Specialize qcqsOrdinaryRestrictionModels to identity-plus-immersion and weakly-etale-plus-identity to get exactness for every immersion, chart and chart-immersion composite used below. By the localization universal property the chosen ordinaryDerivedPull of an exact ordinaryPull is naturally isomorphic to mapDerivedCategory. Lift the proved ordinary pullback identity/composition comparisons to these derived functors using mapDerivedCategoryNatIso and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso.

proof.text: For an isomorphism r, both r and inv r are immersions. Their exact derived restrictions compose to the identity by the comparisons just constructed and inv_hom_id. A map made invertible by r therefore becomes invertible after inv r and hence was invertible already; the forward functorial implication is automatic.

Transport through the exact derived and composition comparisons to obtain precisely j≫r and i≫r.

This proves the cover criterion with its original independent index universe and no boundedness assumption.

theorem qcqsOrdinaryLocalDetection
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (T : Scheme.{t}) [CompactSpace T] [QuasiSeparatedSpace T]
    {H K : D l E T none} (f : H ⟶ K) :
    (∀ (S : Scheme.{t}) [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
      (r : S ⟶ T) [IsIso r],
      IsIso ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).map f) ↔ IsIso f) ∧
    (∀ (S U Z : Scheme.{t})
      [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
      [CompactSpace U] [QuasiSeparatedSpace U]
      [CompactSpace Z] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Z]
      (r : S ⟶ T) [IsImmersion r] (j : U ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ S)
      [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j] [IsClosedImmersion i],
      Set.range j.base ∪ Set.range i.base = Set.univ →
      Disjoint (Set.range j.base) (Set.range i.base) →
      (IsIso ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).map f) ↔
        IsIso ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E (j ≫ r)).map f) ∧
          IsIso ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E (i ≫ r)).map f))) ∧
    (∀ (S : Scheme.{t}) [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
      (r : S ⟶ T) [IsImmersion r] [Nonempty S]
      (I : Type w) (W : I → S.ProEt),
      (∀ a : I, CompactSpace (W a).left) →
      (∀ a : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (W a).left) →
      Presieve.ofArrows W
        (fun a ↦ (MorphismProperty.Over.homMk (W a).hom (Category.comp_id _) :
          W a ⟶ ProEt.mk (𝟙 S))) ∈ ProEt.precoverage S (ProEt.mk (𝟙 S)) →
      (IsIso ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E r).map f) ↔
        ∀ a : I, IsIso ((ordinaryDerivedPull l E ((W a).hom ≫ r)).map f)))
